job.title: IT Accessibility UI/UX Requirements Analyst (IA814303)
job.description:
IT Accessibility UI/UX Requirements Analyst (IA814303)


Key Responsibilities

• Design screens including wireframes, mockups, and interaction patterns for front?end applications.
• Conduct gap analysis between current and desired workflows and document risks.
• Write detailed, well?scoped tickets and user stories in Azure DevOps (ADO) and GitHub.
• Break large feature requests into realistic, properly sized development units.
• Develop personas and convert user needs into actionable design and functional requirements.
• Tag, organize, and refine tickets for clean hand-off to Angular developers.
• Define clear front?end requirements that bridge design, requirements writing, and development needs.
• Support testing activities, including accessibility testing using automated tools, screen readers, and manual keyboard/tabbing tests.
• Potentially contribute to front-end coding or testing, depending on skillset.

Required Qualifications

• Proven experience in UI/UX screen design (wireframes, mockups, interaction design).
• Strong experience writing detailed requirements, user stories, and well?formed tickets.
• Significant hands-on experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) and GitHub for ticket/story workflows.
• Ability to conduct gap analysis, identify risks, and translate findings into actionable requirements.
• Certified accessibility professional (CPACC, WAS, or equivalent).
• Deep understanding of WCAG 2.2 AA, Section 508, and Title I/Title II compliance — with the ability to apply and test against these standards directly.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Working understanding of Angular and general front?end development concepts.
• Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
• Understanding of CI/CD processes and how front-end work moves through pipelines.
• Experience contributing to front?end coding or testing tasks.
• Experience developing personas based on user research.

Skill Set

Business Analysis, Requirements Gathering, Requirements Elicitation, Gap Analysis, Stakeholder Communication, Process Mapping, Documentation, Technical Writing, Figma, UX Design, Wireframing, Interaction Design, USWDS, Design Systems, WCAG 2.2 AA, Section 508, Title I/II, Accessibility Testing (automated tools, screen readers, keyboard navigation), QA/Testing Support, Test Plans, Azure DevOps, GitHub, User Story Writing, Ticket Scoping, Persona Development, SDLC, Agile, Angular (working knowledge), CI/CD, Front-end coding (optional).

Technical Tools & Methods Experience

• Design tools (Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, etc.)
• Accessibility tools (Axe, Wave, Lighthouse)
• Screen readers used (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver)
• Ticketing tools (ADO, GitHub)
• Methods for story scoping, sizing, and refinement
• Gap analysis methodologies used
• Examples of producing developer?ready requirements
• Experience with front-end workflow understanding (Angular, component-based development)

job.title: IT User Experience Designer (NC812491)
job.description:
IT User Experience Designer (NC812491)

Core Responsibilities


Provider Relationship and Navigation (25%)

  • Serve as the DHHS RHTP provider experience champion.
  • Creatively problem-solve process blockers and friction points in response to provider feedback.
  • Create a provider “playbook” that synthesizes process and navigation guidance.



External Partner Coordination (20%)

  • Serve as the liaison between DHHS’ RHIF partner (DIT) and RDHC partner (ECU) to ensure a smooth handover for providers.
  • Communicate process improvement recommendations to partners.
  • Occasionally attend partner meetings.



Provider Journey Analysis (20%)

  • Map and regularly update the provider journey in detail and publish an illustrative workflow.
  • Regularly identify collaboration or provider service gaps.



Continuous Improvement (15%)

  • Identify opportunities for process improvement.
  • Implement process improvements.
  • Conduct surveys, focus groups, and/or listening sessions to collect qualitative and quantitative data on the process.
  • Continuously evaluate existing documentation for updates vis-à-vis current operations and best practices.



Data, Metrics, and Reporting (15%)


  • Establish a provider experience information housing and reporting mechanism.
  • Deliver reports and presentations regarding provider experience.
  • Support development of evaluation measures.
  • Compile data and support reporting for DHHS leadership, CMS, and rural health partners.



Initiative 6 Support (5%)

  • Support data needs of Initiative 6.
  • Support communication needs of Initiative 6.
  • Support presentation needs of Initiative 6.
  • Support provider experience activities in other Initiative 6 activities.






Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Thorough knowledge of process and quality improvement principles.
  • Strong understanding of rural health systems, digital health challenges, and community resource landscapes.
  • Understanding of continuous?improvement tools, service?level agreements (SLAs), and responsible, accountable, consulted, and informed (RACI) ownership frameworks to prevent “no one’s responsibility” gaps.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with clinical audiences, both verbally and in writing.
  • Familiarity with telehealth platforms, EHR workflows, remote monitoring concepts, and practical implementation considerations at small/rural practices.
  • Skill in diagnosing cross?boundary issues, applying structured triage/escalation, documenting status, and driving closure within agreed SLAs.
  • Strong communication skills with a focus on impact and experience convening diverse stakeholders.
  • Ability to recommend and implement responses to moderately complex program or regulatory issues.
  • Ability to travel regularly across rural North Carolina.



Minimum Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in a field related to business, public health, public administration, health administration, healthcare management, nursing, information systems, or a discipline related to the area of assignment; OR an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • One to three (1-3) years of provider relations, program coordination, care coordination, outreach, or telehealth implementation with preference for experience in rural health outreach, digital health solutions, public health programming.
  • Demonstrated process mapping and process improvement abilities.
  • Demonstrated liaising and customer service skills
  • Experience with interfacing with healthcare providers.
  • Familiarity with rural health challenges and resources in North Carolina preferred.
  • Familiarity with federal and/or state contracts and grants.

job.title: IT Mainframe Developer (IA815494)
job.description:
IT Mainframe Developer (IA815494)


Position Summary

The Mainframe Developer will design, develop, modify, test, and support mainframe programs and batch processes that facilitate integration between the legacy Child Support Enforcement system (ICAR) and the new Eligibility Determination system (EDEN). The resource will work closely with business analysts, architects, testers, and technical teams to implement interface updates, maintain data integrity, and support the transition from legacy data sources to modernized eligibility services.

Key Responsibilities

Mainframe Application Development

· Develop, enhance, and maintain COBOL and JCL programs that process interface files between ICAR and EDEN.
· Modify file layouts, data mappings, transformation logic, and validation routines based on business and technical requirements.
· Enhance batch processing workflows, GDG structures, and VSAM datasets to support evolving integration requirements.
· Support modernization efforts by replacing legacy eligibility data sources with EDEN-derived data.
· Maintain and troubleshoot existing production processes and interfaces.

Technical Analysis and Design

· Translate business and functional requirements into technical design specifications.
· Analyze existing mainframe applications and integration points to determine impacts of system changes.
· Modify and support applications that interact with IDMS databases, including schema and subschema navigation.
· Perform detailed record-level and field-level analysis of inbound and outbound interfaces.
· Identify dependencies, integration touchpoints, and risks associated with parallel operation of legacy and modern systems.
· Create and maintain technical documentation, process flows, program specifications, and interface designs.

Testing and Quality Assurance

· Develop unit test scenarios and execute comprehensive testing of mainframe applications and batch jobs.
· Support system, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing activities.
· Investigate and resolve defects identified during testing cycles.
· Validate end-to-end data processing and file exchanges between systems.
· Ensure data quality, processing accuracy, and compliance with business requirements.


Deployment and Operational Support

· Create and maintain JCL, procedures (PROCs), scheduling definitions, and operational documentation.
· Support implementation, migration, and production deployment activities.
· Assist with cutover planning and execution during modernization milestones.
· Troubleshoot production incidents, file processing failures, and data discrepancies.
· Develop operational runbooks, monitoring procedures, and post-deployment support documentation.


Collaboration and Communication

· Partner with project managers, business analysts, developers, testers, and business stakeholders.
· Participate in design reviews, technical walkthroughs, sprint planning, and status meetings.
· Communicate technical risks, issues, dependencies, and recommendations proactively.
· Support knowledge transfer activities and contribute to project documentation.

Required Technical Skills

Mainframe Development

· COBOL programming
· JCL (Job Control Language)
· VSAM datasets, indexing, REPRO/DEFINE utilities
· IDMS database development and support
o Schema/Subschema concepts
o Database navigation
o ADS/O experience preferred
o IDMS COBOL integration
· Batch processing development and support
· Flat file design and parsing
· Data transformation and interface mapping

Batch Processing and Infrastructure

· GDG management and dataset lifecycle administration
· FTP/SFTP processing and troubleshooting
· File transfer automation
· Scheduling tools such as:
o CA7
o Control-M
o Equivalent enterprise scheduling platforms

Integration and Analysis

· Legacy system modernization experience
· Multi-system data integration and interface support
· Technical specification interpretation
· Root cause analysis and troubleshooting
· Data mapping and transformation logic
· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Required Qualifications

· Hands-on mainframe development experience.
· Strong expertise in COBOL, JCL, and batch processing.
· Experience working with IDMS or comparable mainframe database technologies.
· Experience with VSAM datasets and file-processing applications.
· Demonstrated experience supporting application integrations and data exchange processes.
· Experience analyzing and modifying legacy systems.
· Strong verbal and written communication skills.
· Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience supporting Child Support Enforcement systems or Human Services programs.
· Experience with eligibility systems, public assistance systems, or government modernization initiatives.
· Experience with large-scale legacy modernization projects.
· Knowledge of production support, release management, and deployment practices.
· Experience working in Agile or hybrid project environments.

Success Criteria

The selected candidate will successfully:
· Deliver high-quality mainframe code and interface enhancements.
· Support reliable data exchange between ICAR and EDEN.
· Minimize disruption during legacy-to-modern system transition activities.
· Contribute to successful testing, deployment, and production support efforts.
· Maintain system stability while enabling modernization objectives.

job.title: IT O&M Curam Dev (NC814925)
job.description:
IT O&M Curam Dev (NC814925)

Job Details:

NC FAST requires the services of a mid-level Java and Curam developer with experience in providing business and systems analysis, modeling, design and programming for NC FAST application development and maintenance operations using Java, ReactJS and Curam programming technologies.

This resource will have delivery responsibilities as part of NC FAST development and may act as the point of contact on site for development-related questions and issues that arise and work closely with Senior Technical Consultants on design and development issues.

Duties include but are not limited to: leading functional and detailed requirement development, code development, Joint Application Development (JAD) sessions, functional and detailed design, and life cycle management for the implementation of NC FAST.

Areas of focus will include business and workflow process modeling, and business reengineering using Cúram. These activities will involve the use of COTS Cúram Enterprise Framework Components, Cúram Intelligent Evidence Gathering (IEG2), Cúram Express Rules for Triage (CERT), Oracle, use of XML technology in Cúram, Cúram Evidence Framework, Subversion, and WebSphere. Responsibilities also include reporting statuses to the NC FAST Project Manager, and adhering to DHHS policies and procedures.

IT Project Manager (GA815403)

Required experience:

  • Managing complex software development and digital platform implementations, preferably involving cloud-based applications and multiple system integrations.
  • Agile project management, including sprint planning, backlog management, resource coordination, and release management.
  • Cross-functional coordination among software engineers, UX designers, data specialists, business owners, and external technology partners.
  • Managing timelines, budgets, risks, dependencies, and deliverables across parallel workstreams.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps for agile project management, sprint tracking, and backlog management.
  • Proficiency with collaborative project management and documentation tools, such as Confluence, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Smartsheet, or Microsoft Project.

Preferred experience:

  • AI-enabled applications, personalization systems, or data-intensive digital products.
  • Learning technologies, EdTech platforms, LMS integrations, or workforce development systems.
  • Experience managing products from MVP through production and subsequent releases.
  • Familiarity with cloud environments such as Google Cloud Platform, Azure, or AWS.
  • Exposure to enterprise platforms such as Salesforce and Canvas, including system integrations and data workflows.
  • Familiarity with Figma or similar tools for coordinating UX/UI design and prototype development.
  • Experience with dashboards and reporting tools for tracking project progress and performance.

job.title: IT Network/Telecom Specialist (NC815144)
job.description:
IT Network/Telecom Specialist (NC815144)

Position Overview

The North Carolina 911 Board's Network Monitoring and Assistance Center (NMAC) is a 24-hour, 7-day-a-week statewide operations center responsible for monitoring and coordinating technical support for North Carolina's Next Generation 911 (NG911) system.

The NMAC serves as a central point of contact for Public Safety Answering Points (PSAPs), telecommunications providers, and technology vendors throughout North Carolina. Our mission is to help maintain the availability, reliability, and operational readiness of critical 911 services.

We are seeking a dependable, detail-oriented, and technically capable Tier I Network Technician to join our overnight operations team. This position serves as a frontline technical support resource, receiving and documenting service issues, monitoring system notifications, coordinating incident response, and ensuring timely communication with affected 911 centers and technical support partners.

Although the position carries a Network Technician title, the primary responsibilities involve technical monitoring, incident management, customer support, and coordination rather than direct network configuration or administration.

This is an excellent opportunity for individuals interested in information technology, network operations, telecommunications, or public safety technology.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

1. Network and System Monitoring

  • Monitor statewide NG911 network and system dashboards for alarms, alerts, outages, and potential service disruptions.
  • Identify and document abnormal conditions involving network connectivity, 911 call handling equipment, and associated services.
  • Review monitoring notifications and follow established procedures for incident identification, reporting, and escalation.
  • Maintain awareness of ongoing technical incidents and service conditions affecting North Carolina's 911 centers.
  • Assist with tracking service restoration and confirming that reported issues have been appropriately addressed.

2. Technical Support and Incident Management

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for incoming calls and technical support requests from 911 communications centers across North Carolina.
  • Gather detailed information from PSAP personnel regarding reported technical problems, equipment malfunctions, call processing issues, and service interruptions.
  • Create, update, and maintain accurate incident records using the NMAC's Salesforce case management platform.
  • Document troubleshooting activities, vendor responses, incident timelines, and resolution information.
  • Assign incident priorities based on established severity classifications and operational impact.
  • Escalate critical or unresolved incidents to Tier II personnel, technical vendors, or appropriate management.
  • Follow established Standard Operating Guidelines (SOGs) to ensure consistent handling of reported incidents.

3. Vendor and Technical Coordination

  • Coordinate with contracted NG911 service providers and technology vendors, including AT&T, Motorola Solutions, Intrado, RapidSOS, and other support partners.
  • Facilitate communication between PSAP personnel and technical support teams during troubleshooting and service restoration.
  • Monitor vendor ticket activity and follow up on outstanding issues to ensure progress toward resolution.
  • Participate in technical conference calls and incident coordination bridges as necessary.
  • Ensure incidents are appropriately documented, escalated, and tracked through resolution.

4. Customer Service and Communication

  • Provide professional, courteous, and responsive assistance to 911 communications personnel.
  • Communicate technical information clearly to individuals with varying levels of technical knowledge.
  • Provide accurate status updates regarding reported issues, ongoing investigations, and service restoration activities.
  • Recognize the operational importance of 911 services and demonstrate urgency when handling potentially service-impacting incidents.
  • Maintain professionalism and composure during high-priority incidents and stressful situations.
  • Ensure accurate communication and information sharing during shift changes.

5. Documentation and Operational Procedures

  • Maintain complete and accurate records of incidents, notifications, troubleshooting activities, and vendor interactions.
  • Follow established procedures for incident escalation, notification, documentation, and closure.
  • Prepare clear shift turnover notes identifying unresolved incidents, ongoing vendor activities, and items requiring follow-up.
  • Assist with maintaining operational documentation and identifying opportunities to improve support procedures.
  • Participate in training and professional development related to NG911 systems, telecommunications, and incident management.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Strong computer skills and the ability to navigate multiple software applications simultaneously.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated customer service and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to accurately document technical issues and communicate information clearly.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to follow established procedures and work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to prioritize competing tasks and respond appropriately to urgent situations.
  • Willingness to learn specialized telecommunications and public safety technologies.
  • Dependable attendance and the ability to work an assigned overnight schedule.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in an IT help desk, technical support center, network operations center (NOC), or telecommunications environment.
  • Familiarity with basic networking concepts, including IP connectivity, network equipment, and telecommunications services.
  • Experience using ticketing or case management systems such as Salesforce or ServiceNow.
  • Experience working with monitoring dashboards, incident management tools, or technical support applications.
  • Previous experience in a 911 communications center, emergency communications, or public safety environment.
  • Familiarity with NG911 systems, call handling equipment, or emergency communications technology.

Previous 911 experience is not required. Training will be provided on NMAC procedures, supported systems, and incident management responsibilities.

Work Environment and Schedule

The NMAC is a 24/7/365 operations center supporting critical public safety communications infrastructure throughout North Carolina.

  • This position is assigned to the overnight/night shift.
  • Work is performed 100% on-site in Raleigh, North Carolina.
  • The position may require working weekends and holidays based on the assigned schedule.
  • Employees must be comfortable working in a continuously staffed operations environment.
  • The position involves extensive computer use, telephone communication, technical documentation, and monitoring of multiple systems.
  • Technicians must be able to work independently while maintaining communication with other NMAC staff, management, and technical support partners.

Contract-to-Hire Opportunity

This position is initially offered as a four-month contract assignment, with the intent of transitioning the selected candidate into a permanent North Carolina state government position, subject to satisfactory performance, position availability, and applicable hiring requirements.

Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be dependable, curious, organized, and comfortable working in a technology-driven environment. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of assigned responsibilities, communicates effectively, follows established procedures, and understands the importance of supporting mission-critical 911 services.

While technical experience is valuable, reliability, communication skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn are equally important.

This position offers an opportunity to develop technical skills while contributing to the continued reliability of North Carolina's statewide 911 system.

job.title: IT Program Director- Senior (NC814873)
job.description:
IT Program Director- Senior (NC814873)

Tax System Modernization Program Manager

The Program Manager is part of the Transformation Management Office (TMO). The position reports directly to the Program Sponsor (Chief Deputy Secretary) along with the Technical Program Director and Functional Program Director. The individual leads the planning and monitoring of the program.


This role works with various stakeholders on strategic program planning, stakeholder engagement, cross-functional coordination, and program scheduling and resource analysis.


The ideal candidate is well-versed in large transformation programs, has exceptional project management skills, and has experience working within the public sector.

Position Responsibilities:

Project Leadership & Strategy

Ø Collaborate with the tax system vendor and TMO to develop and oversee a comprehensive tax system modernization roadmap including multiple releases with a detailed schedule, resource allocations, and milestones.
Ø Coordinate with the tax system vendor, Technical Program Director and Functional Program Director from planning and analysis to execution and deployment.
Ø Ensure program management best practices are being followed throughout the program, including effective documentation, communication, and change management.
Ø Identify key program risks and ensure risk mitigation strategies and plans are documented to support program success.
Ø Identify and manage decisions, issues and action items to ensure timely resolution to avoid program delays.
Ø Serve as the primary contact for the tax system vendor Project Manager.
Ø Ensure alignment with other NCDOR IT portfolio initiatives identifying and addressing dependencies, resource constraints and conflicts, and risks.
Ø Create and deliver regular status reports, dashboards and Executive Steering Committee presentations and updates.
Ø Submit required information and comply with the Department of Information Technology reporting requirements.
Ø Develop methods to measure and report on program benefits.
Ø Facilitate Executive Steering Committee and Program Management Governance Meetings.
Ø Ensure contractor onboarding and off-boarding happens timely and aligns with resource planning and program schedule.
Ø Oversee technology and service vendor deliverables according to contract and payment milestones.
Ø Collaborate closely with agency IT leads, business analysts, and third-party contractors to ensure effective teamwork.
Ø Manage Change Requests working with the appropriate steering committee or board to present proposed changes and acquire decisions for approval or rejection.

Stakeholder Engagement

Ø Coordinate with other state agencies or third parties to discuss changes needed by other IT departments to support the program (e.g. interface changes).
Ø Collaborate with the Functional Program Director to plan activities associated with the organizational change management strategy and plan.
Ø Participate in planning and attend meetings and discussions with external customers impacted by the new tax system.

Team Management

Ø Lead a cross-functional team of project managers responsible for managing specific aspects of the program (i.e. data conversion, interfaces). Project management staff may fluctuate throughout the life of the program.
Ø Provide guidance, mentorship, and performance oversight to team members.

Budget & Resource Management

Ø Collaborate with Procurement and the TMO Program Directors on timelines for procuring goods and services to support the program timelines.
Ø Maintain and oversee the staffing plan, ensuring sufficient allocation of NCDOR resources to meet program timelines.
Ø Track completion of contract milestones and payment approval; participate in forecasting future budget needs for the program.

Compliance & Risk Management

Ø Collaborate with the Technical Program Director and internal technical team members responsible for adherence to all state, federal, and agency regulations to identify work tasks for inclusion in the program schedule, including dependencies.

Qualifications & Experience
Ø Minimum of 7 years of experience in program or project management. PMP or PgMP certification preferred.
Ø Proven experience managing large-scale modernization or transformation projects, ideally within government or public sector.
Ø Experience with public-sector taxation operations or technologies is a plus.
Ø Experience with Agile project management methodologies is a plus.
Ø Proven experience developing high-quality status reports and dashboards.
Ø Proven experience presenting to executive-level stakeholders.
Ø General knowledge of state and federal regulatory standards for government technology.
Skills
Ø Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
Ø Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact with and engage a wide range of stakeholders.
Ø Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Ø Proficiency in project management software (e.g., MS Project).
Ø Proficiency in Microsoft Office, SharePoint and MS Teams; advanced skills preferred.

job.title: IT Sr Data Governance Analyst (VA815251)
job.description:
IT Sr Data Governance Analyst (VA815251)

Position Summary

DBHDS is seeking an experienced Senior Data Governance Analyst to support the implementation and continuous improvement of enterprise data governance through the effective integration of people, processes, and technology.

The position will collaborate with data owners, data stewards, and enterprise partners to translate governance policies, standards, and decisions into repeatable, sustainable, and measurable business processes that embed data governance into operations and technology delivery.

The ideal candidate is a skilled business analyst and facilitator with a strong understanding of data governance principles who can analyze complex business and data management challenges, interpret policies, elicit requirements, facilitate cross-functional decisions, and translate governance needs into practical solutions.

The role emphasizes governance by design, business process improvement, stakeholder collaboration, operational accountability, and organizational adoption rather than hands-on technical development.

Key Responsibilities

Data Governance Business Analysis and Process Improvement

  • Analyze business processes and data management practices to identify governance gaps, risks, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities.
  • Facilitate requirements elicitation, root cause analysis, and current-state and future-state process design for governance-related initiatives.
  • Translate governance policies, standards, business needs, and decisions into actionable business requirements, workflows, procedures, and operational controls.
  • Develop process maps, business requirements, SOPs, RACI matrices, and performance measures to support governance implementation and accountability.
  • Support process implementation, automation, adoption, and continuous improvement to establish sustainable governance practices.

Governance Facilitation and Enterprise Collaboration

  • Facilitate cross-functional working sessions involving data owners, stewards, business units, enterprise architecture, engineering, security, analytics, and external partners.
  • Facilitate complex discussions, reconcile competing priorities, evaluate alternatives, and support informed governance decisions by authorized stakeholders.
  • Clarify governance decision rights, responsibilities, dependencies, and required actions for implementation.
  • Document governance decisions, communicate requirements and outcomes to responsible teams, and coordinate follow-through to implementation.
  • Foster collaboration and accountability for consistent application of governance practices across business and technical stakeholders.

Data Governance Operations and Continuous Improvement

  • Support data owners and stewards in implementing governance policies, standards, roles, and responsibilities within operational processes.
  • Collaborate with data owners, stewards, and enterprise partners to define, document, and monitor meaningful measures of governance effectiveness, stakeholder engagement, compliance, and data quality.
  • Facilitate data quality issue identification, root cause analysis, remediation planning, and continuous improvement.
  • Support data access governance and data sharing processes by ensuring authorized decisions, requirements, and conditions are clearly documented, communicated to execution teams, and tracked through implementation.
  • Collaborate with enterprise partners to embed governance requirements into data onboarding, integration, management, and consumption.
  • Elicit and document business and analytical requirements to help ensure governed enterprise data products meet consumer needs.

Areas of Contribution

The analyst may lead or support prioritized initiatives involving governance decision processes (Awareness, Risks, Issues, and Decisions — ARID), access governance, data sharing, automated data onboarding, Enterprise Master Person Index (EMPI) and reference data management, data quality improvement, compliance reviews, and data product requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience in senior-level business analysis, requirements elicitation, business process improvement, and complex problem-solving.
  • Advanced facilitation skills, including leading cross-functional working sessions, navigating competing priorities, building consensus, and driving decisions to resolution.
  • Proven ability to analyze, design, document, and support implementation of sustainable business processes.
  • Ability to interpret policies, standards, and business requirements and translate them into practical operational processes, business rules, and controls.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise data governance concepts, including data ownership, stewardship, access governance, data quality, compliance, and data lifecycle management.
  • Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • Five or more years of experience in business analysis, requirements elicitation, process improvement, or related enterprise business functions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting enterprise data governance initiatives, including governance process implementation, data stewardship, data quality, metadata, or access governance.
  • Experience in government, healthcare, or another regulated environment.
  • Familiarity with enterprise data integration, interoperability, master and reference data management, and governed data products.
  • Knowledge of data governance frameworks (e.g. DAMA-DMBOK, DMMI) and process improvement methodologies (BPMN, Lean, Six Sigma).
  • Familiarity with AWS, Snowflake, Commonwealth of Virginia/VITA standards, or relevant professional certifications such as CDMP.

Education

A bachelor's degree in information systems, business administration, information management, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent professional experience and relevant certifications may be considered.

This position is initially offered as a four-month contract assignment, with the intent of transitioning the selected candidate into a permanent North Carolina state government position, subject to satisfactory performance, position availability, and applicable hiring requirements.

Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be dependable, curious, organized, and comfortable working in a technology-driven environment. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of assigned responsibilities, communicates effectively, follows established procedures, and understands the importance of supporting mission-critical 911 services.

While technical experience is valuable, reliability, communication skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn are equally important.

This position offers an opportunity to develop technical skills while contributing to the continued reliability of North Carolina's statewide 911 system.

job.title: IT Full Stack .NET Developer (IA810929)
job.description:
IT Full Stack .NET Developer (IA810929)

Position Overview

- Code samples or a portfolio are required upfront with every submission, including front-end and UI work. Do not submit candidates who cannot provide them. Candidate who are submitted without code samples or portfolio will be rejected. Links can be inputted on the resumes.

DOM DoIT is seeking two senior-level developers focused on .NET development and front-end, UI/UX work to support and enhance enterprise applications serving Iowans across state programs. These are hands-on roles for developers who build the .NET backend and the user-facing front end, and who can hit the ground running with modern best practices.

The current environment uses Bootstrap and Material. The State is transitioning toward an enterprise design system across teams and AWS in the future. Candidates must already understand enterprise design systems and be able to work within one independently, without foundational training. Accessibility is the core purpose of this role. Every deliverable must meet WCAG 2.1 AA and Section 508, and accessibility is weighted as heavily as the technical focus.

These positions are fully remote. Candidates located in Iowa are preferred.

Role Weighting
- .NET and C# development: approximately 40 percent
- Front-end development, UI, and UX: approximately 40 percent
- Middleware and APIs: approximately 10 percent
- SQL Server: approximately 10 percent
- Accessibility: a heavy, core requirement across all of the work above

Key Responsibilities
- Develop, enhance, and support enterprise applications using .NET and C#, including MVC and Web Forms where they remain in the environment.
- Build front-end interfaces using HTML5, CSS, Sass, and JavaScript, translating designs into responsive, production-quality pages and components.
- Apply UX and UI best practices and design thinking in the front end, including layout, interaction patterns, and usability, and collaborate with designers on implementation details.
- Implement and extend components within the current Bootstrap and Material environment and the enterprise design system as it rolls out, understanding how a design system differs from a component library or framework.
- Code to WCAG 2.1 AA and remediate accessibility issues, testing with assistive technologies such as JAWS and automated tools such as axe.
- Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs, with supporting middleware and SQL Server work as needed.
- Apply secure coding practices, including appropriate use of encryption APIs, and handle classified and sensitive data in accordance with state requirements.
- Manage source control, deployments, and CI/CD processes using Azure DevOps.
- Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across applications and environments.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), design, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. A graduate degree in HCI is preferred. A degree in design or HCI combined with a solid coding background is preferred. Multiple degrees and certifications are valued.
- Strong .NET and C# development experience, and strong front-end development experience. These two areas are the core of the role.
- Demonstrated UX and UI knowledge: design thinking, usability principles, responsive design, and experience turning designs into working interfaces. A portfolio should show UI work, not only backend code.
- Front-end depth in HTML5, CSS, Sass, and JavaScript.
- Formal WCAG training and demonstrated experience coding and testing for WCAG 2.1 AA, including hands-on use of accessibility testing tools.
- Recent experience (within the last three years) with current frameworks and modern best practices. Legacy system experience older than three years will not align with the State's upcoming standardization efforts.
- Experience working within an enterprise design system.
- Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
- Working knowledge of SQL Server, APIs, and middleware integrations.
- Experience supporting enterprise production applications, and experience handling classified or sensitive data.

Preferred Qualifications
- Accessibility certification (for example, DHS Trusted Tester, IAAP WAS, or CPACC) or equivalent formal training.
- Experience supporting government or healthcare systems.
- Experience with Angular, GitHub, and AWS services.
- Experience modernizing existing applications rather than building greenfield solutions.

Vendor Submission Guidance
- Code samples or a portfolio are required upfront with every submission, including front-end and UI work. Do not submit candidates who cannot provide them.
- Candidates must arrive at interviews prepared and on time, ready to demonstrate hands-on execution and discuss practical examples, including Web Forms, design systems versus Bootstrap, and Sass and HTML5. Assurances that a candidate can learn quickly on the job are not a substitute for existing proficiency.
- Prior candidate pools missed the mark on at least one core requirement in every case, most often formal WCAG training and hands-on front-end experience. Screen against every core requirement before submitting.
- Highest priority: .NET and C# development, hands-on front-end development with UX and UI knowledge, WCAG accessibility with formal training, and enterprise design system experience.
- Strong preference: CI/CD, classified data handling, and government or healthcare experience.
- Supporting skills: SQL Server, middleware and API development.
- Nice to have: Angular, AWS, GitHub.

Ideal Candidate
- The ideal candidate is a developer who is strong in .NET and equally strong at the front end: they build the interface Iowans actually see, to design standards, accessibly, and they can show that work. They already work the way these teams are moving: modern practices, an enterprise design system, and accessible code tested with real tools, without foundational training or a long ramp-up.
- Primary skill set: .NET, C#, HTML5, CSS, Sass, JavaScript, UX and UI design implementation, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility and testing tools, REST APIs, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, enterprise design systems.
Position focus: accessibility first, with .NET development and front-en

job.title: IT Sr. ServiceNow Developer (GA814871)
job.description:
IT Sr. ServiceNow Developer (GA814871)

Position Summary

The ServiceNow Developer Senior will serve as a senior technical contributor responsible for the design, development, and support of enterprise ServiceNow applications and platform capabilities.

This role partners closely with product owners, service managers, and other technical teams to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions aligned with institutional priorities.

The position requires deep platform expertise, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to mentor other developers while ensuring adherence to platform standards, governance, and best practices.

Local Candidates Strongly Preferred
Candidates working 100% remote is acceptable
Contract Duration: 3-6 months

Preferred Qualifications

Years of Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience in enterprise or large-scale environments
  • 3+ years building and supporting custom applications using App Engine Studio
  • 3+ years working within Agile or sprint-based delivery models

Preferred Education

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field preferred

Preferred Certifications

  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  • ITIL® 4 Foundation (or equivalent ITSM experience)

Preferred Skills

  • Integration & Automation: Implement and support inbound and outbound integrations using Scripted REST APIs and Integration Hub patterns where applicable.

  • Agile Delivery & Collaboration: Participate actively in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and change review processes while collaborating with cross-functional teams.
  • Mentorship & Technical Leadership: Provide guidance to mid-level developers and delegated developers, reviewing code and promoting consistent development standards.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy ServiceNow applications and enhancements across multiple environments

  • Contribute to platform documentation, architectural decisions, and operational runbooks
  • Assist with troubleshooting production issues and implementing long-term corrective solutions

job.title: IT Senior QA Tester (IA813111)
job.description:
IT Senior QA Tester (IA813111)

Position Overview

The Department of Education is seeking a Senior QA Tester to support ongoing enhancements to applications used for monitoring and administering Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA) grants, including Parts B and C. Current project initiatives include the addition of two AEA funding streams, a fiscal monitoring tool, and three stand-alone form upload processes supporting budget and claims workflows.

This role will be responsible for both manual and automated testing, with a primary emphasis on manual testing and automation where appropriate. The ideal candidate will have experience developing and executing test plans, validating business and technical requirements, performing API and database testing, and supporting defect triage activities throughout the software development lifecycle.

The Senior QA Tester will collaborate closely with business analysts, developers, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions meet functional, usability, accessibility, and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform a variety of software testing activities including:
  • Functional Testing
  • Regression Testing
  • User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
  • Usability Testing
  • Accessibility Testing
  • Develop, execute, and maintain manual test cases, test scripts, and test plans.
  • Utilize testing tools to support and expand automated testing efforts where practical.
  • Review business requirements and technical documentation to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts to clarify requirements and develop test scenarios, including limited requirements gathering activities necessary for test planning.
  • Perform API testing and database validation to ensure data accuracy and system integrity.
  • Execute SQL queries to validate application functionality and data processing.
  • Document testing results, defects, and recommendations.
  • Participate in defect triage activities, troubleshooting, and production support efforts as issues arise.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure changes are successfully migrated into production environments.
  • Support projects ranging from small enhancements to large-scale application initiatives.
  • Assist with maintaining user and system documentation as business processes evolve.
  • Participate in business process improvement and validation activities.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Quality Assurance and Software Testing experience.
  • Strong experience with manual testing methodologies and best practices.
  • Certified in accessibility (e.g., CPACC, WAS, or equivalent) with a thorough, deep understanding of accessibility principles and WCAG 2.2 AA standards, not just surface-level familiarity.
  • Experience creating and maintaining automated test scripts.
  • High-level proficiency with:
  • SQL queries and database validation
  • API testing and web service validation
  • Experience developing test plans, test cases, and test documentation from business requirements.
  • Ability to analyze requirements and translate them into comprehensive testing strategies.
  • Experience tracking and managing defects through the software development lifecycle.
  • Certification in Accessibility Testing.
  • Knowledge of Section 508 Accessibility Standards.
  • Experience testing applications for government accessibility compliance.
  • Familiarity with accessibility testing tools and methodologies.
  • Experience validating WCAG and Section 508 compliance requirements
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, developers, project managers, and other IT teams.
  • Experience working in Agile or similar collaborative development environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting government applications or public-sector technology environments.
  • Experience testing compliance-driven or grant management systems.

job.title: IT Security Analyst 2 (VA814128)
job.description:
IT Security Analyst 2 (VA814128)
REMOTE BUT MUST LIVE IN VIRGINIA
All interviews are in-person with no exceptions.

The statements below describe the principal duties of the position and are not intended to be all-inclusive.

• Conduct and coordinate security risk assessments, Business Impact Analyses, data classifications, privacy reviews, control assessments, and security feasibility reviews for new and existing systems, applications, services, integrations, and technology initiatives.

• Maintain risk registers, assessment records, corrective-action plans, exceptions, evidence repositories, and follow-up activities in Archer GRC and other approved agency tools. Track remediation commitments, due dates, residual risk, and required executive decisions.

• Apply and interpret Commonwealth and agency requirements, including VITA SEC530, NIST guidance, CIS Controls, DoD STIGs, CJIS and VCIN requirements, and applicable HIPAA, PCI, FERPA, FTI, privacy, and contractual obligations.

• Partner with system owners and data owners to establish ownership, classify information, document security plans and controls, complete periodic reviews, and maintain evidence needed for authorization, audit, and ongoing compliance.

• Review vendor and third-party security documentation, including SOC reports, security questionnaires, architecture and data-flow information, contracts, MOUs, MOAs, NDAs, and other interconnection documentation. Identify conditions, gaps, compensating controls, and escalation needs.

• Support interconnection and data-sharing governance by reviewing MOUs and related agreements for security, privacy, least-privilege, data-handling, access-control, incident-notification, and annual-review requirements.

• Coordinate audit, assessment, and oversight activities; collect and validate evidence; respond to inquiries; document findings; and manage corrective actions through closure with internal audit, VITA, and other authorized reviewers.

• Develop, maintain, and communicate security policies, standards, procedures, guidelines, templates, and governance processes. Recommend practical improvements that strengthen compliance and reduce risk.

• Support the agency security awareness and training program, including targeted compliance training, acknowledgements, tracking, reporting, and education for system owners, technical staff, and other stakeholders.

• Perform governance reviews for emerging technology and artificial intelligence initiatives. Evaluate business purpose, data sensitivity, privacy, security, human oversight, vendor assurances, risks, and required approvals; document outcomes and handoffs.

• Assist with security planning for continuity, incident response, disaster recovery, business continuity, audit logging, configuration and hardening, access reviews, vendor management, and other control areas.

• Prepare accurate executive, management, and Commonwealth reporting on governance workload, system inventory, risks, findings, remediation progress, compliance status, metrics, and program priorities.

• Provide clear security guidance to project teams, operational IT, procurement, business units, and vendors. Facilitate meetings, communicate requirements professionally, and escalate unresolved risk or noncompliance through established channels.

• Participate in incident and post-incident governance activities as assigned, including documentation review, control-gap identification, privacy or regulatory coordination, and corrective-action tracking.

• Perform other related duties and special projects in support of the IT Security Governance program.

Knowledge Skills and Abilities
• Knowledge of cybersecurity governance, risk management, compliance, privacy, third-party risk, and audit practices.

• Knowledge of security frameworks and standards such as NIST 800-53, VITA SEC530, CIS Controls, CJIS and VCIN requirements, HIPAA, PCI, FERPA, FTI, and related Commonwealth requirements.

• Ability to analyze technical and business information, identify risk, distinguish control gaps from acceptable residual risk, and recommend clear, defensible actions.

• Ability to develop and maintain professional documentation, including assessment reports, risk registers, security plans, policies, procedures, executive briefings, and audit evidence.

• Ability to manage multiple complex assignments, prioritize work under deadlines, and follow through on actions involving many stakeholders.

• Ability to communicate effectively with executives, technical teams, vendors, auditors, and nontechnical business partners.

• Ability to handle sensitive information with sound judgment, discretion, and a service-oriented approach.

Desired Qualifications
These qualifications would strengthen a candidate's application but would not be mandatory.
Experience and Skills

  1. Archer GRC: 3+ years of experience using Archer or comparable governance, risk, and compliance platforms.
  2. VITA SEC530: 2+ years of experience applying Commonwealth of Virginia information security requirements.
  3. Third-Party Risk Management: 3+ years reviewing vendor security documentation, SOC reports, and security questionnaires.
  4. Business Impact Analysis: 3+ years conducting BIAs, data classification reviews, and security feasibility assessments.
  5. Regulatory Compliance: 3+ years working with CJIS, VCIN, HIPAA, PCI DSS, FERPA, or FTI requirements.
  6. Privacy and Data Sharing: 2+ years reviewing data-sharing agreements, MOUs, and security/privacy obligations.
  7. Incident Response and Continuity Governance: 2+ years supporting incident response, disaster recovery, or business continuity compliance.
  8. AI and Emerging Technology Governance: 1+ year assessing security, privacy, and compliance risks associated with emerging technologies.
  9. Executive Reporting: 3+ years preparing security metrics, compliance reports, risk summaries, and management briefings.

Works with application development teams to identify application issues at the customer level and provide technical detail in order for development teams to accurately identify problems within applications.

Project Management -
Ability to lead projects that require directing the work of others and with some latitude on actions or decisions. Leads team efforts and assesses and integrates the skills and strengths of individuals for project and organizational success. Provides status on project work to management.

Develop and maintain appropriate documentation for all responsible areas -
This position is responsible for creating and maintaining all documentation of process and procedures for all areas this position is responsible for. This documentation is to be used by team members for operational standards of daily work. This documentation will also be used in accordance with Operational Level Agreements (IT internal) and Service Level Agreements (IT external). All documentation should be reviewed annually.

job.title: IT Security Analyst 2 (VA814125)
job.description:
IT Security Analyst 2 (VA814125)

All interviews are in-person with no exceptions.
The statements below describe the principal duties of the position and are not intended to be all-inclusive.


• Conduct and coordinate security risk assessments, Business Impact Analyses, data classifications, privacy reviews, control assessments, and security feasibility reviews for new and existing systems, applications, services, integrations, and technology initiatives.


• Maintain risk registers, assessment records, corrective-action plans, exceptions, evidence repositories, and follow-up activities in Archer GRC and other approved agency tools. Track remediation commitments, due dates, residual risk, and required executive decisions.


• Apply and interpret Commonwealth and agency requirements, including VITA SEC530, NIST guidance, CIS Controls, DoD STIGs, CJIS and VCIN requirements, and applicable HIPAA, PCI, FERPA, FTI, privacy, and contractual obligations.


• Partner with system owners and data owners to establish ownership, classify information, document security plans and controls, complete periodic reviews, and maintain evidence needed for authorization, audit, and ongoing compliance.


• Review vendor and third-party security documentation, including SOC reports, security questionnaires, architecture and data-flow information, contracts, MOUs, MOAs, NDAs, and other interconnection documentation. Identify conditions, gaps, compensating controls, and escalation needs.


• Support interconnection and data-sharing governance by reviewing MOUs and related agreements for security, privacy, least-privilege, data-handling, access-control, incident-notification, and annual-review requirements.


• Coordinate audit, assessment, and oversight activities; collect and validate evidence; respond to inquiries; document findings; and manage corrective actions through closure with internal audit, VITA, and other authorized reviewers.


• Develop, maintain, and communicate security policies, standards, procedures, guidelines, templates, and governance processes. Recommend practical improvements that strengthen compliance and reduce risk.


• Support the agency security awareness and training program, including targeted compliance training, acknowledgements, tracking, reporting, and education for system owners, technical staff, and other stakeholders.


• Perform governance reviews for emerging technology and artificial intelligence initiatives. Evaluate business purpose, data sensitivity, privacy, security, human oversight, vendor assurances, risks, and required approvals; document outcomes and handoffs.


• Assist with security planning for continuity, incident response, disaster recovery, business continuity, audit logging, configuration and hardening, access reviews, vendor management, and other control areas.


• Prepare accurate executive, management, and Commonwealth reporting on governance workload, system inventory, risks, findings, remediation progress, compliance status, metrics, and program priorities.


• Provide clear security guidance to project teams, operational IT, procurement, business units, and vendors. Facilitate meetings, communicate requirements professionally, and escalate unresolved risk or noncompliance through established channels.


• Participate in incident and post-incident governance activities as assigned, including documentation review, control-gap identification, privacy or regulatory coordination, and corrective-action tracking.


• Perform other related duties and special projects in support of the IT Security Governance program.


Knowledge Skills and Abilities


• Knowledge of cybersecurity governance, risk management, compliance, privacy, third-party risk, and audit practices.


• Knowledge of security frameworks and standards such as NIST 800-53, VITA SEC530, CIS Controls, CJIS and VCIN requirements, HIPAA, PCI, FERPA, FTI, and related Commonwealth requirements.


• Ability to analyze technical and business information, identify risk, distinguish control gaps from acceptable residual risk, and recommend clear, defensible actions.


• Ability to develop and maintain professional documentation, including assessment reports, risk registers, security plans, policies, procedures, executive briefings, and audit evidence.


• Ability to manage multiple complex assignments, prioritize work under deadlines, and follow through on actions involving many stakeholders.


• Ability to communicate effectively with executives, technical teams, vendors, auditors, and nontechnical business partners.


• Ability to handle sensitive information with sound judgment, discretion, and a service-oriented approach.
Desired Qualifications
These qualifications would strengthen a candidate's application but would not be mandatory.
Experience and Skills

  1. Archer GRC: 3+ years of experience using Archer or comparable governance, risk, and compliance platforms.
  2. VITA SEC530: 2+ years of experience applying Commonwealth of Virginia information security requirements.
  3. Third-Party Risk Management: 3+ years reviewing vendor security documentation, SOC reports, and security questionnaires.
  4. Business Impact Analysis: 3+ years conducting BIAs, data classification reviews, and security feasibility assessments.
  5. Regulatory Compliance: 3+ years working with CJIS, VCIN, HIPAA, PCI DSS, FERPA, or FTI requirements.
  6. Privacy and Data Sharing: 2+ years reviewing data-sharing agreements, MOUs, and security/privacy obligations.
  7. Incident Response and Continuity Governance: 2+ years supporting incident response, disaster recovery, or business continuity compliance.
  8. AI and Emerging Technology Governance: 1+ year assessing security, privacy, and compliance risks associated with emerging technologies.
  9. Executive Reporting: 3+ years preparing security metrics, compliance reports, risk summaries, and management briefings.

job.title: IT Senior Automation Engineer (NC814383)

job.title: IT Data Scientist- Senior (NC813224)
job.description:
IT Data Scientist- Senior (NC813224)

Job Details:

RMA is seeking a Data Scientist - Senior to support the DIT-T / DOT’s rapid expansion of its enterprise data capabilities through Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, and modern analytics platforms. This contractor will be a dedicated resource focused on establishing consistent enterprise data practices that span both technical teams and business units as they are building data ingestion, transformation, cleansing and analytics solutions.

The contractor will provide the organization with an experienced consultant who can work directly and collaboratively with business units to understand how they define, interpret, and use their data, and then translate those needs into consistent enterprise standards.

This role will help refine business-critical data elements, improve data definitions and lineage, and establish reusable patterns that align both technical and business perspectives. By partnering closely with business owners, the consultant will strengthen data quality, improve confidence in enterprise data, and reduce friction caused by inconsistent or unclear business rules.

The ideal candidate has advanced, specialized expertise in enterprise data strategy, governance, and modern data architecture that cannot be performed by an early?career resource.

The position is responsible for establishing foundational, organization?wide data management practices and must operate as the initial member of a new Data Strategy & Governance function. This requires a high level of independent judgment, architectural leadership, and hands?on experience with complex data platforms.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with business stakeholders, application teams, Database Administration, Data Engineering, Power BI, and project teams to understand data needs and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Facilitate discussions to identify authoritative data sources, establish common business definitions, and improve understanding of enterprise data assets.
  • Work with project teams to incorporate practical data governance, metadata, lineage, and data quality practices into ongoing initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize and reuse data ingestion, transformation, cleansing, and validation patterns across projects using Azure Data Factory and Azure Databricks.
  • Help develop and maintain an inventory of enterprise data assets, including data owners, stewards, business definitions, and system relationships.
  • Collaborate with business and technical teams to document how data flows across applications, platforms, and reporting solutions.
  • Participate in data architecture and solution design discussions to promote consistency, scalability, and reuse across enterprise data solutions.

The State Corporation Commission (SCC) is seeking an Endpoint Engineer to support enterprise software and patch deployment activities. This role is responsible for reviewing endpoint vulnerability metrics and executing remediation through targeted software and patch deployments. The engineer will troubleshoot deployment failures, patching issues, and configuration problems, providing detailed root?cause analysis and corrective actions. Additionally, the position contributes to maintaining a secure, compliant, and reliable endpoint environment across the organization.

• Implement and enforce endpoint hardening policies, compliance settings, and configuration baselines.

IT HMS Analyst (NC813952)

Sample Role Types:

Healthcare Systems Analyst, EHR Optimization Specialist, Health IT Analyst

Expected Skills:

Able to work successfully with guidance; cannot provide leadership to others; able to manage simple to medium complexity work efforts.


This position supports the HIE Medicaid Services (HMS) program, a collaboration between NC HIEA and the NC Department of Health and Human Services (NCDHHS) Division of Health Benefits (DHB), also known as NC Medicaid.


Part of this program focuses on enhancing Medicaid quality and population health efforts through improved data exchange, focusing on:

1. Transitioning to digital quality measures (dQMs),

2. Improving health-related social needs (HRSN) data exchange, and

3. Enhancing care management data sharing.

The HMS Analyst will support the implementation, expansion, and ongoing operations of Medicaid data exchange services within NC HIEA, with a strong focus on improving HRSN data capture and onboarding early adopters. This role is responsible for translating program and partner needs into clear technical and workflow requirements, supporting Continuity of Care Document (CCD) / Admission-Discharge-Transfer (ADT) data integration efforts, and coordinating cross?team activities to enhance data quality and interoperability.


The analyst will work closely with internal teams and external stakeholders to troubleshoot issues, guide testing and onboarding, and ensure that new data connections are implemented accurately, securely, and in alignment with statewide population health priorities.


The position requires strong analytical skills, deep familiarity with health information exchange standards, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non?technical partners.

Additional skills/experience should include:

job.title: IT Web Developer / Web Accessibility Specialist (GA812760)
job.description:
IT Web Developer / Web Accessibility Specialist (GA812760)

Work Schedule: 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM

Work Location: Hybrid (Onsite 3 days/week and remote 2 days/week)

Job Description

RMA is seeking a detail-oriented Web Developer / Web Accessibility Specialist to join our Office of Strategic Communications / Digital Services team. This position is responsible for assisting in the department’s efforts to audit, remediate, and maintain all web content and digital assets across GDOT’s online channels to ensure full compliance with the new ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) Title II standards, WCAG 2.1 AA/2.2 standards, and Section 508 guidelines.

The ideal candidate possesses extensive expertise with Microsoft SharePoint, strong web development skills (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), and experience managing digital accessibility issues in web pages, electronic documents, and embedded media.

Key Responsibilities

ADA Compliance & Remediation

  • Perform comprehensive manual and automated accessibility audits on DOT public websites, portals, and web applications using tools like Site improve and AccessiBe.
  • Remediate non-compliant HTML, CSS, JavaScript, interactive tools, and web structures across all digital channels.
  • Ensure all web-published digital assets (PDFs, videos, forms, graphics, presentations, photos, and GIS maps [KL1.1]) comply with WCAG 2.1 AA standards and Section 508.
  • Assist with web accessibility testing on new and existing content.
  • Work closely with content creators, communications team, IT personnel, and third-party vendors to enforce web accessibility best practices.

SharePoint Development & Content Management

  • Manage, maintain, and update web pages and custom components within GDOT’s SharePoint environment.
  • Create and modify custom SharePoint templates, web parts, page layouts, and CSS/JS integrations to ensure out-of-the-box and custom features comply with accessibility guidelines.
  • Implement proper ARIA roles, landmarks, and semantic HTML structure within SharePoint pages.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Web Development, Graphic/Digital Design, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Experience: 2+ years of professional experience as a Webmaster, Front-End Developer, or Web Accessibility Specialist.

Technical Skills

  • SharePoint Expertise: Proven hands-on experience managing and developing within Microsoft SharePoint Online and SharePoint Server.
  • Accessibility Standards: In-depth knowledge of ADA Title II requirements, WCAG 2.1 / 2.2 Level AA guidelines, WAI-ARIA standards, and Section 508.
  • Front-End Development: Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and responsive framework concepts.
  • Document Remediation: Knowledge of PDF remediation tools (Adobe Acrobat Pro DC) and accessible document creation in Microsoft Office

    Soft Skills
  • High attention to detail and strong analytical/problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple compliance projects simultaneously while meeting strict deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical accessibility guidelines to non-technical users.
  • Willingness to share expertise and knowledge to assist in creation of process development for internal teams to assist in continued compliance going forward.

The candidate must have experience in solutioning from both a technical and functional perspective and must be able to understand and help clarify client requirements, design, and build the solution leveraging multiple resources/teams utilizing Salesforce and other platforms.


The engineer must participate in exploring business needs, architectural analysis, development, testing, production support, and system maintenance.
Duties include requirements gathering, designing, and implementing solutions, and supporting go-live and post-implementation.


The Integration/Interface engineer position has responsibility for providing hands-on development, design, implementation, and support of business solutions based on MuleSoft technology. job.title: IT Project Management/System Security (NC812047)

Job Details:

***This is a hybrid position. All contractors are working remote, but they may come onsite occasionally for training.
***The candidate must currently be living in NC.
***The candidate will be required to come onsite their first day to collect equipment.


RMA is seeking a Technical Specialist resource for an engagement to work with the Accounts Team. This candidate serves as an advanced level resource with specialized knowledge and experience in account management.

Demonstrates expertise in conveying technical and functional concepts for data protection. Accounts and Access Management uses technical expertise in the Operations and Security of an Information Technology Infrastructure and an understanding of business needs to evaluate assigned IT incident and problem user requests to appropriately prioritize and evaluate business impact.

Candidate performs advanced level professional work in account administration and analyzes information to create and/or modify accounts for new employees and/or existing employees. Functions as a niche technical subject matter expert (SME) in Active Directory with a high technological skill level. Ability to troubleshoot data and application access issues and adjust Active Directory properties as needed.

Ability to independently resolve problems through advanced system analysis and troubleshooting procedures. Receives, logs and fully documents requests from the business using ServiceNow. Ability to capture incidents and resolve incidents within ServiceNow and issues identified by the business with the ability to document resolutions providing weekly status reports to Management.

Considerable knowledge as demonstrated by an understanding of critical information technology operations and security. Provides the knowledge and skills of DOT and ITS security policies, as well as the security issues directly affecting the systems and technology for which employees are directly involved.

They are responsible for implementing requirements of the IT Security Office and protecting data from unauthorized access, alteration, destruction, or usage in a manner inconsistent with covered IT policies and standards.

This function requires an in-depth understanding of a wide variety of technologies to effectively support end-users and provide guidance to others. This work requires very strong communication skills, an ability to effectively interact with a broad range of end-users and others, as well as an ability to use a variety of resources for providing support.

Employees at this level typically provide advanced support for a broad range of technologies, or in-depth support for a more narrowly defined area of technology. Proven experience with a technical specialty across large and complex implementations and systems.

Project Management -
Ability to lead projects that require directing the work of others and with some latitude on actions or decisions. Leads team efforts and assesses and integrates the skills and strengths of individuals for project and organizational success. Provides status on project work to management.

Develop and maintain appropriate documentation for all responsible areas -
This position is responsible for creating and maintaining all documentation of process and procedures for all areas this position is responsible for. This documentation is to be used by team members for operational standards of daily work. This documentation will also be used in accordance with Operational Level Agreements (IT internal) and Service Level Agreements (IT external). All documentation should be reviewed annually.

System Security -
It is the responsibility of all Technical Services Staff to be aware of DOT and ITS security policies, as well as the security issues directly affecting the systems and technology for which this position is directly involved. This position is responsible for implementing requirements of the IT Security Office and protecting data from unauthorized access, alteration, destruction, or usage in a manner inconsistent with covered IT Security Policies and standards.

job.title: IT VISION ETL Lead (IA812372)
job.description:
IT VISION ETL Lead (IA812372)


Position Summary

The Lead ETL Developer will design, build, test, and deploy data ingestion and migration pipelines that source historical and real-time data from a variety of disparate systems, including flat files and relational databases.

The developer will transform and standardize incoming data into enterprise data models and ensure efficient, accurate loading into data warehouses, data lakes, and analytical databases.


This role is responsible for ensuring that transactional and analytical data models include required data elements and meet quality, reliability, and performance expectations.

The Lead ETL Developer will mentor and guide a team of ETL developers, establishing best practices and consistent development patterns throughout the project lifecycle.

Responsibilities

  • Lead development of ETL and data ingestion processes supporting the migration from GCP BigQuery to SQL-based data warehouse environments.
  • Architect and implement pipelines using modern ETL tools and cloud-native data processing frameworks.
  • Train and mentor a team of 4+ ETL developers on best practices, coding standards, and data model design.
  • Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to validate data requirements and ensure alignment with reporting and analytical needs.
  • Develop robust testing strategies to ensure data integrity, completeness, and accuracy throughout the migration process.
  • Optimize pipelines for scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Validate transactional and analytical data models to ensure they contain the necessary elements for downstream applications and BI solutions.
  • Prepare and deliver clear communication, presentations, and technical documentation suitable for both technical and non-technical audiences.


Required Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 7 years of hands-on ETL development experience.
  • Expertise with modern ETL and reporting/BI tools.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data models and best practices in ETL pipeline design.
  • Proven experience as a Technical Lead guiding teams of 4 or more developers.
  • Demonstrated experience with:
  • Google Cloud Dataform
  • BigQuery
  • Medallion Architecture
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, capable of engaging diverse audiences.

job.title: IT Cybersecurity Engineer 3 (VA811203)
job.description:
IT Cybersecurity Engineer 3 (VA811203)

Cybersecurity Engineer

The Cybersecurity Engineer develops and implements advanced cyber defense solutions for the agency, safeguards the infrastructure, and assures that the system is built to specification and is deployed successfully.

We are seeking a highly analytical and technically proficient Cybersecurity Engineer supporting Splunk SIEM. You will play a critical role in defending our organization against cyber threats by leveraging Splunk Enterprise Security to monitor, detect, analyze, and respond to security events.


The ideal candidate has strong expertise in log analysis, threat hunting, and writing Splunk queries to identify and contain malicious activity.

Key Responsibilities

·Threat Detection & Monitoring: Continuously monitor network traffic, endpoint logs, and cloud security events for anomalous behavior and potential security incidents.

·Splunk Management: Create, maintain, and tune Splunk correlation searches, alerts, and dashboards to minimize false positives and improve detection capabilities.

·Incident Response: Investigate potential security incidents, follow forensic evidence, and collaborate with IT and network teams to remediate threats.

·Use Case Development: Develop and refine detection and response playbooks based on threat intelligence and frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK.

·Log Integration: Work with infrastructure teams to onboard new data sources, ensuring log integrity, parsing, and normalization across the SIEM platform.

Compliance & Reporting: Support audit readiness by collecting SIEM control evidence and generating compliance reports aligned with internal policies and standards
